locations.note: Novelist Alan Wake comes on holiday with his wife Alice; after she vanishes he fights the Taken through the woods to a gas station, is taken to the police station, meets a fake kidnapper in the national park, and with Sheriff Breaker's help reaches Cynthia Weaver and the Clicker at the dam.
Alan stops for the keys to the rented cabin and gets them from a mysterious old woman in black instead of the landlord, Carl Stucky.
Alice is dragged into the water from the island cabin; Alan later wakes in Dr. Hartman's lodge above the lake, escapes it, and in the end dives in to free Alice from the Dark Place.

routes.name: Alan Wake
routes.note: From the diner to the island cabin, back to town after Alice vanishes, to Hartman's lodge on the lake, back to town and the Clicker, and down into the lake.
